capabilities: run SQL queries in code blocks against inline CSV, vault files (CSV/TSV/JSON/parquet), or remote URLs
reference markdown tables in notes via datasource anchors
render query results as read-only tables
render query results as charts using a small DSL or raw ECharts options
configure CDN mirror, DuckDB memory limit, and query timeout in settings
extras: Desktop only. Loads the DuckDB-WASM engine and .wasm module from a CDN (jsDelivr by default, configurable), so initial use requires network access; queries then run locally and no data leaves the vault. CSV/TSV columns are read as text, so numeric or date casting in SQL is required for charting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query, aggregate, or visualize the tabular data stored in notes and vault files from within a note.
summary: Runs SQL queries over inline CSV, markdown tables, vault files, or remote URLs in code blocks, rendering results as tables or ECharts charts.
